segments.text: 🎯 GATE 8 — Day 175 · MOCK #14: Monitoring / Observability Platform।
What: The Phase 8 checkpoint — designing the very system that makes reliability measurable, testing whether that operational maturity is now reflexive.
How to complete: Sit the mock cold, timed to 45 minutes, then score yourself against: write volume, cardinality, time-series storage, query.

Don't move on until you can truthfully check off:
Every design handles partial failure by default, unprompted
